lines.t: One of the most famous horror games ever was made by a man who used to make Christian games.
His name is Scott Cawthon. Players said the beaver in one of his kids games looked like a creepy animatronic.

sc.sub: what players called his cute beaver

lines.t: So he leaned into it, and made something scary on purpose.
Five Nights at Freddy's came out in August 2014. You're a night guard in a pizza place, from midnight to six A M.
The animatronics, Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy, wander the halls at night, hunting you.
You can't move. You watch the cameras, shut the doors, and try not to run out of power.
YouTubers like Markiplier, PewDiePie and Jacksepticeye screamed at it on camera, and millions watched.
Then came three sequels in under a year. That's a Guinness World Record.
Fans have made thousands of their own versions, enough to get their own category on Game Jolt.

sc.label: OF FAN GAMES
sc.sub: Game Jolt gave them their own category

lines.t: The 2023 movie made nearly 300 million dollars, a record for its studio, Blumhouse.
A second movie followed in December 2025.
And the eleventh main game, Secret of the Mimic, arrived in June 2025.
Which animatronic scares you the most? Comment for which game we should review next! Follow for more!
